# FlowForge

> FlowForge is open-source (AGPL-3.0), self-hosted workflow automation with AI voice agents that runs on ordinary PHP shared hosting (Hostinger hPanel, cPanel, DirectAdmin) or a VPS. It is an alternative to n8n, Zapier and Make: no Docker, no Node.js on the server and no per-task fees. One cron job runs everything.

- Repository: https://github.com/DeveloperSarim/FlowForge
- Documentation: https://developersarim.github.io/FlowForge/
- Full reference (features, voice agents, install, FAQ): https://developersarim.github.io/FlowForge/llms-full.txt
- Releases and downloads: https://github.com/DeveloperSarim/FlowForge/releases
- Latest version: 1.8.0 (October 2026)
- Stack: PHP 8.2+, Laravel 12, MySQL, React 18 with Inertia, Tailwind CSS
- Author: Sarim (DeveloperSarim). Installation and hosting services: support@sarimtools.com

## What it does

- Visual workflow builder: triggers, actions, If/Else branches and filters on a drag-and-drop canvas, with a step editor that maps data between steps.
- 1,690 app integrations with 8,700 actions and 800 triggers (Gmail, Slack, Google Sheets, HubSpot, Shopify, WooCommerce, Stripe, OpenAI, Telegram, WhatsApp and more), plus an HTTP request step for any API.
- AI Builder: describe a workflow in plain words and it builds it, using your own OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, DeepSeek or Qwen key.
- AI voice agents: an AI receptionist or calling agent that answers and makes phone calls, books appointments and saves every call with its recording, transcript and summary. 12 templates (clinic, salon, restaurant, hotel, car service, gym, store, lead qualification, reminders, support, real estate, feedback). Free test calls in the browser; real calls through Vapi or ElevenLabs, with more than 11,000 ElevenLabs voices in over 30 languages including Urdu, Hindi and Arabic.
- Triggers: webhooks, schedules in plain words, app triggers that watch for new items, manual runs, error triggers, and voice call/booking triggers.
- MCP server so Claude Code, Cursor and other AI agents can build and run workflows.
- Custom apps: when a service isn't in the catalog, the AI builder adds it from the service's API, or you import its OpenAPI file.
- Workflow import and export as files (without credentials), including rebuilding n8n workflows with the AI builder.
- Automatic retries like Zapier's Autoreplay: failed runs retry from the failed step (2 min to 6 h), with an Auto-retry switch per workflow; each step can retry, keep going on failure or be turned off.
- AI providers: OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, or a custom OpenAI-/Anthropic-compatible API (OpenRouter, Groq, Ollama, LM Studio).
- Team roles and permissions, encrypted credentials, step-by-step run debugger, email alerts, one-click updates from GitHub with backup and rollback, phone-friendly layout.

## Install

1. Download flowforge-install-x.y.z.zip from the latest release.
2. Create an empty MySQL database in your hosting panel.
3. Upload and extract the zip into your domain's folder.
4. Open https://your-domain.com/install and follow the setup wizard.
5. Add the one cron job it shows: * * * * * php artisan schedule:run
